title: Findings triage -> SIEM ownership & RBAC remediation map
summary: Working document to triage penetration-test findings into a prioritized SIEM ingestion + RBAC v2 remediation plan. Maps each finding to evidence buckets, SIEM dashboards/alerts, automation owners, and a pragmatic remediation/QA schedule.
purpose: Provide a single-page, actionable mapping from pen-test findings to who owns SIEM ingestion, what audit/log schema is required, what RBAC v2 policy changes are needed, and the automated evidence collection steps for compliance reviewers.
scope: This doc covers external and internal penetration engagements in CY2024–2025 that involve: privilege escalation, misconfigured roles, missing audit events, SIEM export gaps, and evidence packaging. Does NOT cover application-level functional bugs without security impact.
background: Recent red-team/3rd-party engagements uncovered a mix of telemetry gaps (missing actor_type in audit events), RBAC misbindings in legacy service-accounts, and inconsistent SIEM ingestion paths for Dedicated and Private deployments. Security and platform teams agreed to coordinate remediation through this triage map so that evidence automation and SIEM dashboards align with RBAC v2 rollout.
triage_matrix:
Format: [Finding short id] | Severity | Root cause | Evidence path | SIEM owner | Remediation owner | ETA
- F-2024-11-01 | high | missing 'actor_type' in audit schema for private-deployments | gs://evidence/pen-tests/2024-11/f-2024-11-01/ | eng-observability | eng-platform-rbac | 2025-01-15
- F-2024-11-04 | medium | role-binding allowing legacy-admin role to service account | gs://evidence/pen-tests/2024-11/f-2024-11-04/ | sec-ops | eng-platform-rbac | 2025-02-05
- F-2024-12-02 | critical | audit export to Splunk missing request_id correlation causing orphaned alerts | s3://siem-exports/pen-tests/2024-12/f-2024-12-02/ | eng-siem | eng-observability | 2024-12-20 (hotfix)
- F-2025-01-08 | low | KV cache telemetry floods logs with PII (sanitization gap) | gs://evidence/pen-tests/2025-01/f-2025-01-08/ | eng-privacy | eng-serving-runtime | 2025-02-28
siem_export_queries: Splunk savedsearch: pen_test_orphaned_alerts: index=main source=audit_logs (NOT request_id) | stats count by actor_id, action, resource_type
Datadog: log query: @pen_test:true AND @request_id:missing | group_by(@actor_id) | top 50
Correlation query (cross-index): join audit_events by request_id with request_traces to find missing correlations where event_count>1 and trace is null
audit_log_schema_requirements: Required fields: timestamp, request_id, actor_id, actor_type (user|service|system), action, resource_type, resource_id, outcome (success|failure|denied), ip, user_agent, region, deployment_mode (hosted|dedicated|private)
Schema versioning: enforce 'audit_schema_version' header on export (v2.1 for RBAC v2 rollout)
PII rules: never include request_body in raw export; store hashed identifiers for user_email and api_key_id
rbac_v2_actions: Create JIRA: RBAC-1024 - remove legacy 'admin-all' clusterrole binding from svc-account 'legacy-deployer' (owner: eng-platform-rbac)
Create JIRA: RBAC-1025 - add least-privilege templates for 'dedicated-readonly' and 'private-admin' roles (owner: eng-platform-rbac)
Backfill policy audit: run policy-scan across all orgs and emit findings to 'rbac-audit' index in SIEM (owner: eng-observability)
Rollout plan: canary 10% tenants -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback if errors > 0.5%
automation_playbooks: evidence-ingest-lambda: AWS Lambda script that converts raw audit ndjson to Splunk format and uploads to s3://siem-processed/pen-tests/<id>/
gcs-folder-watcher: Cloud Function that triggers when new evidence zip appears and starts verification job (sha256+manifest check)
rbac-change-detector: nightly job that diffs current bindings with canonical RBAC v2 template and creates tickets for deviations
splunk-correlation-automation: once a request_id appears without trace, auto-scan trace-store and attach trace_id when found (status annotated in SIEM alert)
evidence-packager: small CLI used by red-team to produce final artifact tarball including manifest.json, signer metadata, and scrubbed-samples
remediation_schedule: High/critical items: aim to hotfix SIEM export and audit-schema gaps within 7 business days. Medium items: remediation work in next sprint (2–4 weeks). Low items: backlog triage; scheduled in regular RBAC backlog. See per-finding ETAs in triage matrix. All remediation tickets must include: test checklist, QA steps, linked evidence path, and post-remediation SIEM savedsearch updated.
qa_checks: End-to-end validation: run pen-test evidence through ingestion pipeline and verify Splunk savedsearch returns expected events
Schema validation: automated JSON schema validator against 'audit_log_schema_v2.1' for every exported file
RBAC regression testing: run canary tenant with synthetic tests that exercise admin-only endpoints
Alert sanity: ensure new/updated SIEM alerts have documented false-positive suppression rules
communication_plan: Notify stakeholders via #sec-pen-tests Slack channel when a critical finding is triaged. Weekly digest email to stakeholders with status updates for all open pen-test JIRAs. For enterprise customers impacted by Private deployments, send a templated customer notice after remediation is complete and evidence package is available.
open_questions: 1) Should we standardize on one SIEM export format (NDJSON vs Splunk HEC) across Dedicated and Private? 2) Who signs off on PII-sanitization for evidence packages (sec-ops or legal)? 3) Acceptance criteria for RBAC v2 rollout (error thresholds, performance metrics).
next_steps: 1) Owners to open remediation JIRAs (if not already) and attach evidence path. 2) Eng-observability to schedule quick hotfix for Splunk request_id correlation (JIRA-SIEM-429). 3) eng-platform-rbac to prepare canary plan and list of tenants for phased rollout. 4) Schedule tabletop with compliance + SRE for evidence-handling SOPs (target: 2025-02-01).
